Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp

Class RecoveryCodesPageController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp.RecoveryCodesPageController
All Implemented Interfaces:
RecoveryCodesPageApi
@Controller public class RecoveryCodesPageController extends Object implements RecoveryCodesPageApi
Serves the page that shows, once, the recovery codes generated when an authenticator app was enrolled during the sign-in, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes it through the generated RecoveryCodesPageApi. The codes are taken out of the session as the page is rendered, so a reload shows none; its "Continue" button resumes the request the sign-in interrupted (kept by the session request cache), or goes to the root when there is none.
